title: Tabular Python
description: Reliable pandas/SQL-shaped work: joins, group-bys, assertions, and traceable pipelines.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can write a pandas join with the keys and expected cardinality written down, and trace three rows through it by hand — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can add an assertion that fails if a join explodes, unpack a chained one-liner into named steps, and keep the pipeline in versioned code a clean clone can run.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently build a group-by that matches a stated grain, write assertions on row counts and keys, and produce a pipeline another person can step through without a notebook cell dump.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose a wrong aggregate as a join or group-by grain error, cite the exploding key or duplicated row, and produce a note that names the failed assertion and the fix.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's pandas pipeline, name a join without a cardinality note or an assertion that cannot fail, and teach how to trace a row through an unfamiliar pipeline.
